Class HelloWorld

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
app.HelloWorld
public class HelloWorld extends javafx.application.Application
Main application class for the ATypical Day JavaFX game.

This class creates the main hallway scene, initializes the player, doors, task display, stats menu, help menu, and story intro. It also controls switching between the main scene and the different room scenes.

    • start

      public void start(javafx.stage.Stage stage)
      Starts the JavaFX application and builds the main game scene.

      This method initializes the player, hallway background, room doors, task bar, stats display, help button, room navigation, and story intro scene.

      Specified by:

      Parameters:
      stage - the main stage used to display all game scenes

    • updateStatsBars

      public static void updateStatsBars()
      Updates the social battery and social standing progress bars.

      If the user or progress bars have not been created yet, this method safely skips updating those values.

    • updateTasks

      public static void updateTasks(javafx.scene.control.Label t1, javafx.scene.control.Label t2, javafx.scene.control.Label t3, javafx.scene.control.Label t4)
      Updates the task labels shown in the task bar.

      This method displays the active tasks, marks completed tasks with a strikethrough style, and clears unused task labels.

      Parameters:
      t1 - the first task label
      t2 - the second task label
      t3 - the third task label

    • handleChoice

      public static void handleChoice(int option, String taskId, javafx.stage.Stage stage)
      Handles the result of selecting a dialogue option.

      This method updates the user's stats, advances the matching task by one step (or completes it if it was on its last step), refreshes the task display, and switches to the game-over scene if the stat change causes a game-over condition.

      Parameters:
      option - the selected dialogue option number
      taskId - the id of the task advanced by the dialogue choice
      stage - the main stage used to switch to the game-over scene
